nodes.title: Room data
nodes.description: Your suite, its furniture and their compartments in one data file, taken from your sketch and table. Which pieces exist, where they stand and which way they face are fixed for now.

nodes.title: Furniture picker
nodes.description: A dropdown plus a simple clickable floor plan of the suite. Picking a piece opens its front view.

nodes.title: Front view
nodes.description: A to-scale drawing of one piece from the front: panels, shelves, hanging rail, drawers, cabinets.

nodes.title: Measurements
nodes.description: Edit the size of a whole piece and of its shelves and compartments. Panel, shelf and divider thickness are part of the model, so inside sizes are calculated.

nodes.title: Organizers
nodes.description: Add a box (small, medium, large, or a typed size), name it, drag it to another shelf, delete it. A box shows coloured stripes for what is inside; clicking it opens it.

nodes.title: Clothing
nodes.description: Add a clothing item with a name, a type and a colour. Put it in a box, on a shelf, or on a rail, and drag it between them. An always-visible "unsorted" tray holds things not yet placed.

nodes.title: Shape and fold
nodes.description: Each item starts as its laid-flat shape: a body with sleeves, or hips with legs. A per-item fold setting reshapes it: flat, halves, thirds, quarters, rolled, hung.

nodes.title: Saving
nodes.description: Autosaves in the browser, plus "download backup" and "restore backup" for one file.

nodes.title: Start: first iteration complete
nodes.description: Milestone. The trunk (T1 to T8) is built and usable. Every branch grows from here.

nodes.title: Corner room view
nodes.description: The room built in Three.js from the room data. Fixed camera at each corner, rotate buttons, zoom, near walls cut away. Click a piece to open its front view.

nodes.title: Top-down view
nodes.description: A fifth camera looking straight down: the 3D version of the floor plan.

nodes.title: Pixel-art style
nodes.description: Low-resolution rendering, a limited warm palette and dark outlines. Original art, no game assets.

nodes.title: Art style toggle
nodes.description: Switch between the pixel style and a plain one in settings.

nodes.title: Contents in the room
nodes.description: Open-fronted furniture shows its boxes and clothing colours in the corner view.

nodes.title: Find-it highlight
nodes.description: A chosen item glows in the room while everything else turns grey and see-through.

nodes.title: Move and rotate furniture
nodes.description: Change where a piece stands and which way it faces, by dragging in the floor plan or top-down view.

nodes.title: Resize rooms
nodes.description: Type new dimensions for the rooms themselves.

nodes.title: Furniture builder
nodes.description: Add new furniture; add or remove shelves, rails, drawers and dividers.

nodes.title: Depth rows
nodes.description: Front and back rows on deep shelves, or a top-down look into one shelf or box.

nodes.title: Walking character and quests
nodes.description: The Godot stage: a character who walks to things, with quests such as "find your passport". Reads the same data file.

nodes.title: Quick add
nodes.description: Type or paste many names, one per line, to create clothing items in one go.

nodes.title: Capacity meters
nodes.description: Each rail shows length used; each shelf and box shows how full it is; overfull ones are flagged.

nodes.title: Tabbed item pop-up
nodes.description: The Stardew-style menu with tabs: Look, Details, Size & Fold, Notes, Location. Built so later tabs slot in.

nodes.title: Opacity and patterns
nodes.description: A transparency slider and basic patterns (stripes, dots, checks).

nodes.title: Notes
nodes.description: Free text per item: comfort, memories, whether it was a gift, souvenir or heirloom.

nodes.title: Detail tags
nodes.description: Tag categories with starter options: category, fabric type, activity, season, temperature, care, comfort, weight. Several values per category, all optional.

nodes.title: Custom categories
nodes.description: Add, rename and remove categories and their options.

nodes.title: Custom defaults
nodes.description: Choose the default look for new or unfinished items and default values per category.

nodes.title: Composition
nodes.description: Materials with percentages, shown as a pie chart.

nodes.title: Custom shapes
nodes.description: Add or remove parts on any item (a hood, a wide skirt panel) beyond the type's starter shape.

nodes.title: Custom folds
nodes.description: Define a fold step by step (thirds across, then halves down) and save it under a name.

nodes.title: Care symbols
nodes.description: Pick laundry symbols; hovering explains each one.

nodes.title: Photos on items
nodes.description: Attach photos, shown in the pop-up and in search results.

nodes.title: Other item kinds
nodes.description: Toiletries, makeup, art and sports supplies, each with their own categories.

nodes.title: Duplicate and multi-move
nodes.description: Copy an item; select several and move them together.

nodes.title: Text search
nodes.description: Type a name, get matches, click one to jump to its furniture with the item highlighted.

nodes.title: Filters
nodes.description: One filter per tag category.

nodes.title: Grid and list results
nodes.description: Grid shows pictures only; list shows the details too.

nodes.title: Result picture choice
nodes.description: A dropdown for which picture results show: flat shape, folded box, or location in its closet with the surroundings muted grey.

nodes.title: "Haven't seen this" nudges
nodes.description: Tracks when items were last moved or worn and lists the forgotten ones.

nodes.title: Printable labels
nodes.description: Print a label for each box listing its contents.

nodes.title: Units toggle
nodes.description: Switch between inches and cm. (Start shows inches.)

nodes.title: Undo
nodes.description: Step back through recent changes.

nodes.title: Permanent web address
nodes.description: Host the app on GitHub Pages; free because the repo is public. Adds a file outside roomorg/.

nodes.title: Install as an app
nodes.description: Works offline and installs to a phone or laptop home screen.

nodes.title: Phone and laptop sync
nodes.description: The same data on every device. Needs an account-based store or a small server.

nodes.title: One-click Codespaces
nodes.description: A setup file so a codespace installs and starts the app by itself. Lives outside roomorg/.

nodes.title: Flat-lay display
nodes.description: The item drawn laid flat at full size, as a display option.

nodes.title: Mannequin, front and back
nodes.description: A simple shop mannequin with clothing placed on body regions, and a skin colour picker.

nodes.title: Styles per item
nodes.description: Several ways to wear one item (a scarf as a top or a belt), with a toggle.

nodes.title: Outfit board
nodes.description: From the home screen, combine items in layers on one mannequin or across several.

nodes.title: Mannequin proportions
nodes.description: Height, leg-to-torso ratio and hair, saved per mannequin.

nodes.title: Body-part search
nodes.description: Drag over parts of the body to find clothes that cover them.

nodes.title: Drape controls
nodes.description: Adjust flare and how many waves a skirt makes.

nodes.title: Wardrobe palette
nodes.description: A chart of every colour you own.

nodes.title: Warm, cool and season tags
nodes.description: Tag items as warm or cool, or by colour season.

nodes.title: Colour reference card
nodes.description: A printable card to photograph beside clothes so colours can be corrected.

nodes.title: Measure from a photo
nodes.description: Use a ruler, tape or coins in the photo to work out an item's flat size.

nodes.title: Photo on a person
nodes.description: Use a worn photo to adjust how the item sits on the mannequin.

nodes.title: Photo to layout
nodes.description: Build furniture or room layouts from photos by tapping corners or automatic outlines.

nodes.title: Care-tag photo
nodes.description: Read care symbols and composition from a tag photo.

nodes.title: Receipt or cart import
nodes.description: Create items, with details filled in, from a receipt or cart screenshot.

nodes.title: Compare when updating
nodes.description: Upload several photos of an existing item and compare them with its saved data.

nodes.title: Tag suggestions
nodes.description: Suggest tags from typed or dictated notes.

nodes.title: Plain-language search
nodes.description: Describe what you want in words.

nodes.title: Photo and outfit matching
nodes.description: Match a photo of you wearing something, or an outfit inspiration picture, to your items.

nodes.title: Packing suggestions
nodes.description: Account for squish and suggest the best arrangement for a space.

nodes.title: App-store version
nodes.description: Wrap the web app for app stores.

nodes.title: Donations and privacy policy
nodes.description: A free web version with optional support, and a written privacy policy.
